items.title: Database Connection Pooling
items.description: A complete guide to database connection pooling — how connections work, pool mechanics, HikariCP tuning, pool sizing formulas, failure modes, PgBouncer, RDS Proxy, and production observability. Beginner through senior depth.

items.title: Performance & Monitoring
items.description: Identifying slow queries, profiling tools, key metrics, connection pooling, and practical optimization workflow.

items.title: What Actually Breaks When Your App Gets Popular (System Design Evolution)
items.description: Comprehensive breakdown of failure modes when applications scale from a single server to millions of users — session traps, connection pool exhaustion, replication lag, cache stampede, synchronous HTTP bottlenecks, AI vector scaling, and the architectural judgment rubric based on JavaScript Mastery fundamentals.
